  <style>

    .p3 { offset-path: path("M300 300 L300 490"); animation-delay: 1s; }
    .p4 { offset-path: path("M300 300 L110 300"); animation-delay: 1.5s; }

    .wave { animation: sway 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    @keyframes sway { from { transform: translateX(-14px); } to { transform: translateX(14px); } }

    @keyframes beat { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.12); } }
    .tent { animation: tent 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    @keyframes tent { from { stroke-opacity: .35; } to { stroke-opacity: 1; } }
  
    .spin { transform-origin: 300px 300px; animation: rot 24s linear infinite; }
    .un { animation: rot 24s linear infinite reverse; }
